body.x: LG Electronics (LG), Korea's major consumer electronics, mobile communications and home appliances maker, introduced G Flex2, LG's second model of curved smartphone with new and improved features at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

The G Flex2 has a 700mm radius curved profile for a sleeker and more dynamic look. The curves ranges from a radius of 400mm to 700mm across the front, back, sides and top-to-bottom edges. This brings the microphone closer to the mouth, for better sound pickup compared to conventional smartphones. The curve also makes a better fit for eyes and the grip.

The display’s resolution went up to 1080p Full HD for crispier UI detail. The P-OLED display, which gives the G Flex2 its unique shape and durability, is even more precise than in the original G Flex. The back of the phone has "Spin Hairline Pattern" for a subtle polish. Also, G Flex2 is protected from everyday nicks and scratches with the "Self Healing" back with reduced healing time from about three minutes to just within ten seconds at room temperature.

The camera of G Flex2’s has a very fast focus system by measuring the distance between the subject and the camera using a laser beam. It is combined with LG’s proven OIS+ technology and dual LED flash to deliver the best result.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.
